secrets.name: TMDB_API_KEY
secrets.description: TMDB API key for movie/TV catalog browsing and search. Get a free key at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api

secrets.name: CONSUMET_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional root URL of a self-hosted Consumet instance (e.g. https://consumet.your-domain.com). Enables anime playback on the anime watch route only; empty keeps the honest 'Playback unavailable' state. VEYRA never falls back to a public instance.
